audit.claiming: claimPromotionBonus() inside withTransaction with FOR UPDATE row lock
audit.idempotency: Enforced via unique active user_bonuses check
audit.identityDeduplication: Enforced via assertIdentityHasNotClaimedPromo on PAN/Aadhaar hashes
audit.depositValidation: Strictly verified against transactions WHERE type='DEPOSIT' AND status IN ('SUCCESS', 'COMPLETED')
audit.budgetSafety: Atomic budget subtraction; throws PROMOTION_ERROR: Promotion budget exhausted
audit.wageringProgress: Tracked via processBonusWageringProgress() on qualifying bets (odds >= 1.50)
audit.release: releaseCompletedBonus() marks status RELEASED once wagering_completed >= wagering_required
audit.expiry: expireStaleBonuses() marks expired and deducts from bonus_balance
audit.financialIsolation: Bonus funds cannot be directly withdrawn without turnover completion
